_doc: Bambu Lab X1 Carbon with the stock 0.4 mm nozzle and Bambu Studio defaults. kind: spec (manufacturer), default (slicer setting), community (widely used rule of thumb), measured (your own test print; beats the rest), estimate (a reasoned guess: measure it).
name: x1c

line.rule: Bambu Studio's default line width for a 0.4 mm nozzle: walls are whole numbers of lines
line.source: Bambu Studio 0.4 mm nozzle process profile

layer.rule: Default layer height; heights that matter should be whole numbers of layers

wall_min.rule: Thinnest wall worth printing: two lines

hole_comp.rule: Printed holes and slots come out small: widen them by this much
hole_comp.source: Common FDM practice; tune with a test print

fit.rule: Gap between parts that slide together
fit.source: Common FDM practice; tune with a test print

print_gap.rule: Narrowest gap between parts printed in place, side by side, that still prints apart (a flexure and the frame round it, a shuttle in its slot): the gap each side, not the total
print_gap.source: A reasoned guess for a 0.42 mm line; measure it with the fit test plate (examples/bench/projects/launcher/objects/fittest)

overhang.rule: Steepest overhang from vertical that prints without supports

bridge.rule: Widest gap a flat underside can span with no support (the widest circle that fits in it)

support_gap.rule: Gap between a built-in breakaway support and the part: one layer, so it snaps off

chamfer.rule: Chamfer bottom edges instead of rounding them, against first-layer squish
